name: Flowers of Sadism, Mass
body:
School transmutation [pain]; Level antipaladin 3, cleric/oracle 4, lathspell 3, magus 4, occultist 4, psychic 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as flowers of sadism, except as noted above.
